implementation: Transient file target ownership extracted from parent while actual read, active, operation and feedback gate stay in parent.
Visual targets require exact actual preview, current successful display/page and confirmed factory-created source. No persisted anchor can create a live selection.
Confirmation rechecks owner, current policy, edit gate, exact preview and source after renderer callbacks; original independent synchronous gate-revocation counterexample is preserved.
Invalid visual input holds the edit guard; refresh staging preserves old pixels but retires selection, and explicit reread clears pending target.
Image-area can return to whole-file target, PDF-area to current-page target; changing target preserves existing opinion text and never sends.
